title: Extract fedi-did crate
description: DID handling extracted from gaja/broadside/smallhold. did:key (Ed25519 multicodec), did:web, did:plc, BIP-39 mnemonic recovery, DID document generation. Source: broadside did.rs (most complete did:web_document) + gaja did.rs (did:plc). Deps: ed25519-dalek, bip39, multibase, sha2, serde_json, thiserror.
